newsitem.title: USA: Atmel sees flat Q4 from low book-to-bill.
newsitem.headline: Atmel sees flat Q4 from low book-to-bill.

text.p: Atmel Corp said on Thursday that fourth quarter revenues and profits could be flat because of a low book-to-bill ratio and increased competition.
The company said its book-to-bill ratio fell below 1.0 during the third quarter, and competition increased for its EPROM business.

"Fourth quarter revenues and profits could be flat with the third quarter as we proceed to replace some of the EPROM business with new products, which should help us continue our growth in 1997," the company stated.
Earlier on Thursday, the company reported third quarter profits of $0.53 per share on net income of nearly $53 million and revenues of more than $280 billion.
The company's stock was down 3-1/8 to 31 in early morning trading.
